question: Can a single fixed lightweight student trained with confidence-2 ARKitScenes metric depth avoid A3's conservative collapse and pass the prospective truth-referenced P1 R1 gate?
new_information_source: ARKitScenes sensor metric depth restricted to confidence value 2; P1 TUM RGB-D remains unopened until checkpoint and cache hashes are locked

model.decoder: fixed 96-channel three-level additive FPN, 32/16-channel full-resolution refinement, softplus metric-depth output plus 0.1m

data.truth_rule: lowres_depth millimetres divided by 1000, confidence equals 2, finite, and depth in [0.25m,6m]

teacher_cache.role: low-weight centered-log relative-structure regularizer only; forbidden as metric truth

training.precision: fp16 autocast with FP32 optimizer state
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest parent-disjoint validation total loss across the fixed five epochs; ties choose earliest epoch

p1_execution.evaluation_protocol: prospective P1 R1, with inherited R0 depth and task gates plus truth status/state/transition, false-block, and harmful-change gates
p1_execution.pass_rule: all P1 R1 engineering noninferiority gates
p1_execution.android_profile: authorized only after P1 R1 engineering pass

forbidden: change architecture, loss weights, epochs, seed, training roles, truth confidence rule, or checkpoint selection after training or P1 output
train or select on TUM P1 RGB-D truth
run multiple A4 seeds or checkpoints and select by P1
re-evaluate or relabel A1, A2, or A3 under R1
profile a P1-failed A4 and use speed to rescue quality
claim cross-device, product, or safety validity from ARKitScenes-to-TUM Development evidence
